card.name: Section headings in drug label outlines
card.fires_on: Marks inside section headings and cross-references in drug labels, such as the start of 'Reactions', the dot in '5.4', or 'Admin' beginning a new instruction. It fires at a boundary where a new heading or sentence begins.

modes.label: Section numbers and headings
modes.description: The dot in a section number or the start of a heading word like Reactions.

modes.label: Cross-reference words
modes.description: Partway through 'Contraindications' inside a bracketed see-reference.

modes.label: Start of instruction sentence
modes.description: The word 'Admin' starting a sentence that tells how to give the drug.
modes.example: ( 2.3 ).<< Admin>>ister TZIELD by intravenous infusion once

card.plain: It fires at points in a drug label where a heading, section number or cross-reference is being written.
